# Version 4.151.4
> **Windows native scanning compatibility** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.4)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.4 corrects the Windows HarfBuzz disabled-warnings BinSkim error.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz scanning compatibility** — Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged. ([#5122](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5122))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.104

Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
